description: This file contains startup classes for the OrchardCore.Indexing module, configuring services for indexing, content handling, recipes, deployment, and background tasks.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Main startup class for OrchardCore.Indexing, configuring core indexing services.

classes.name: ContentStartup
classes.description: Configures indexing services related to content management, enabled with 'OrchardCore.Contents' feature.

classes.name: RecipesStartup
classes.description: Configures recipe steps for index profile management, enabled with 'OrchardCore.Recipes.Core' feature.

classes.name: DeploymentsStartup
classes.description: Configures deployment sources and steps for index profiles, enabled with 'OrchardCore.Deployment' feature.

classes.name: WorkerStartup
classes.description: Configures background worker task for content indexing, enabled with 'Worker' feature.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Sets up dependency injection services for each startup class.
